chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Abdul Samad ibn Bashir, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) entered Medina, he drew a line around it with his foot, then said: 'O Allah, do not bless the one who sells its four corners.'

key_terms.رِبَاعَهُ: Its four corners (referring to land plots or properties)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (peace be upon him) say about selling the four corners of Medina?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in al-Kafi, highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) establishment of Medina’s sacred boundaries (haram) by physically marking them, a practice that conferred spiritual sanctity and economic regulation upon the city. The invocation against those who sell 'ribah' (often interpreted as the four corners or prime plots of land) underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on preventing the monopolization of essential urban spaces and ensuring equitable access for the community. This act serves as a foundational precedent for Islamic urban planning and the prohibition of exploitative real estate practices in early Islamic society.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Abdul Sammad Bin Basheer, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> entered Al-Medina, he<sup>saww</sup> drew a line by his<sup>saww</sup> leg, then said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The one who sells its four corners, so do not Bless it for him’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufiy from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from ‘Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar from, who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam has said, that when the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, arrived in al-Madinah
he drew a line around its houses and said, ‘O Allah, do not make it a blessing for those who sell its houses.”’
